result.description: Agentic document platform: parse, extract, split, classify and edit documents for AI pipelines.
result.auth_detail: API key created in Studio, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer $REDUCTO_API_KEY'. No OAuth for third-party apps; single key per account.
result.access_detail: Standard pay-as-you-go plan, self-serve signup in Studio, includes $150 free usage, then per-page rates. Growth and Enterprise are contact-sales but not needed for API access. The pricing FAQ was collapsed, so I did not read it.
result.api_notes: REST at platform.reducto.ai. Endpoints: Parse, Extract, Split, Classify, Edit and Pipeline, each with an async variant. Also Upload, Delete upload, Jobs (get, list, cancel, delete), Configure webhook and Version. SDKs for Python, Node.js and Go. I only verified the Parse path.

evidence.quote: Reducto is the agentic document platform for AI teams who need production-grade document processing at enterprise scale.
This allows the SDK to authenticate automatically without hardcoding the key in your code.
